newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Corp buys 17 pct of Israel Chem.
newsitem.headline: Israel Corp buys 17 pct of Israel Chem.

text.p: The Israel Corp on Sunday exercised its option to purchase an additional 17 percent stake in Israel Chemicals from the government, paying 667 million shekels in cash at a ceremony held at the Treasury.

The purchase brings Israel Corp's total stake in Israel Chemicals to 41.9 percent. The government still holds 31.5 percent of the chemical holding company while 25 percent is traded on the bourse. The remaining shares are held in trust for the company's employees.
The purchase price, based on the share price over the previous 90 days, values Israel Chemicals at 3.9 billion shekels.

The ceremony took place just three days after the death of the billionaire chairman of the Israel Corp, Shoul Eisenberg, who suffered a heart attack last Thursday in Beijing. He is to be buried in Israel later on Sunday.

Eisenberg's son-in-law Yigal Diamant is president and CEO of Israel Chemicals while his son Erwin Eisenberg is president and CEO of the Israel Corp, one of the major investment companies operating in Israel.
The Treasury said the ceremony was held so soon after Eisenbeg's death because Sunday was the last day that the Israel Corp could exercise its option.
